decisions.reason: It has stayed visible on its own webpage across two years and fits the firm's core integrated equipment offer, so its results likely meet aspiration levels or are close enough to justify retention given the firm's R&D base and slack.

As a distant product outside the firm's main dental and hearing-system focus, it is more likely to fall short of aspiration levels and be reallocated out in favor of the stronger established business and nearer innovation projects.

Although still newly launched and only lightly featured on the website, it is close to the firm's digital production trajectory and complementary to its existing systems, so management is likely to keep it while learning about market acceptance.
